# makensis v3.12
#
# `makensis -CMDHELP`, verbatim, checked in so the census runs with no NSIS
# installed. Regenerate with:
#
#     makensis -CMDHELP > tables/cmdhelp-3.12.txt   # then re-add this header
#     cargo run -q -- generate table tables/cmdhelp-3.12.txt > src/table/generated.rs
#
# `tests/census.rs` diffs both directions: the generated file against this
# snapshot, and this snapshot against whatever `makensis` is on PATH (skipped
# when it is absent).
